description: Two-arm matmul microbenchmark that can discriminate bandwidth from MXU tiling, replacing M15 which could not. Every cell reports implied GB/s and FLOP/s; cells below a utilisation floor are refused rather than interpreted.
note_floor: M15 ran at 7% of peak bandwidth and its curve was per-dispatch overhead. Any cell below 20% of either roof is dispatch-bound and is reported but not interpreted.

arms.name: real_shapes
arms.note: Real qkv shape, amortised over 200 iterations so dispatch is divided away. Tests m13's frontier: flat to M~240, rising after.

arms.name: tile_probe
arms.note: Small resident weights so bandwidth is NOT the binding constraint and MXU tile width is the only structure left. This is the only arm in which a knee at M=4 is identifiable.
